source_identity.canonical_title: Sans l'extrême droite, il n'y aurait pas eu d'"affaire Mila"

translation.canonical_title: Without the far right, there would have been no "Mila affair"
translation.displayed_title: Without the far right, there would have been no "Mila affair"
translation.summary: The far right was very quick to take offense that the left did not display the same performative outrage, conveniently “forgetting” that it was entirely the far right’s fault that the affair had such an impact. Teenagers being harassed following an unfortunate social media post is sadly commonplace and never makes headlines, except when it enables political exploitation as here; the far right therefore behaved like an arsonist firefighter.

source_parameters.name: citation
source_parameters.value: On constate que, quelque temps plus tard, Identitaires et pseudo-laïques se sont disputé la primeur du « combat pour Mila », revendiquant d’avoir été en première place pour « la défense » de l’adolescente… Mais les faits sont têtus : c’est bien la fachosphère qui a lancé l’affaire, et son hashtag a enregistré des scores de likes et de partages sans commune mesure avec ceux espérés par ses suiveurs, lesquels, en l’ayant adopté, lui ont assuré cette '''confortable résonance'''.

citations.translated_citation: Some time later, we see that Identitarians and pseudo-secularists competed to claim precedence in the “fight for Mila,” asserting that they had been at the forefront of the teenager’s “defense”... But the facts are stubborn: it was indeed the far-right online sphere that launched the affair, and its hashtag received numbers of likes and shares far beyond anything its followers could have hoped for; by adopting it, they gave it this '''comfortable resonance'''.
